Text: Crushed underfoot. They didn't even notice.
One careless step. That was all it took.
The cat was just playing. You were not.
To it, you were a toy. Game over.
The cat was bored. You paid the price.
The queen will not be pleased.
The bag is packed. The door is locked. Game over.
Where did you even sleep last night?? ...Fine. Whatever. Just do it.
Since you're already out, you may as well pick a few things up on your way home.
Don't you dare forget a single thing on that list. And get home.
You said 5 minutes. That was 45 minutes ago.
Hello?? Did you get stepped on or something??
I'm not mad. I'm DONE. Get. Home. Now.
Already know the controls? Press [Q] to skip.
Okay. [W][A][S][D] to move. Let's do this.
Mouse to look around. Keep it steady.
[SHIFT] to sprint. [SPACE] to jump. [R] to roll. Got it.
Wait — the map. Shops should be marked on it. Focus.
Okay... there's an arrow. Just follow it. I can do this.
That glowing spot — that's where it is. Go.
Right — the errand list. [TAB] — don't forget.
Can't upset the queen. Every single item. No excuses.
She's furious... I drank way too much last night. My stomach is wrecked.
Pharmacy first. I need a hangover cure.
Avocado. Fruit stall. Don't get a bruised one.
Grab a banana too. Don't forget.
Eggs. From the mart. Don't get cracked ones.
Daddy!! Can we have pizza tonight?? PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE!!
Daaaddy... donuts... pleeeease?? We'll be SO good, we promise!!
Ice cream. You know the one. Don't get the wrong kind.
Oh! The ice cream Mom likes — it's from the guy with the PINK HAT at the shop!!
...She always loved those flowers. Maybe they'll help.
...it's not like I HAVE to, though.
Where do you think you're going?? I'm not done with you. Finish the errands first.
Quit the game?\nYour wife exits the marriage.
You made it. Against all feet.
